title: York, Pennsylvania anchor parks and trail inventory

selection.rule: Eight high-value public destinations serving York city and the surrounding York County park system, selected for regional scale, repeat visitor value, distinctive facilities, or their role as a major trail or water-access anchor.
selection.followUpScope: Inventory the remaining York City neighborhood parks and York County destinations only after this anchor packet clears launch-guide review.

sourcePolicy.identityAndOperations: Current City of York and York County facility pages control identity and operating facts; dated brochures supplement stable physical and subsite facts.
sourcePolicy.coordinates: County facility-page coordinates are retained as official facility pins. City park coordinates use the destination selected by the City's own Get Directions link. The downtown rail-trail arrival uses the City's listed address with an OpenStreetMap address-point cross-check because the City's destination link resolves several miles south of the listed York address.
sourcePolicy.alerts: Current operator-wide notices override older facility copy. Seasonal and closure facts remain fast-changing and must be rechecked before launch-guide publication.
sourcePolicy.imageRights: No operator images are imported. An image displayed by the City or County is not treated as reusable without a license or written permission; aerial imagery is not an acceptable hero-photo substitute.

publicationGates: Complete and source the recurring visitor-answer set for each parent.
Obtain at least one representative, real, reuse-cleared ground-level photograph before any launch guide is published; four varied photographs remain the super-enrichment target.
Resolve the Heritage Rail Trail York arrival pin and the William Kain postal-address conflict before navigation is published.
Recheck seasonal water features, nature-center schedules, trail conditions, hunting closures, and facility reservations immediately before publication.
Promote only named subsites with exact coordinate provenance, destination-specific visitor answers, and their own reuse-cleared photograph.

reviewQueue.conflict_or_missing_evidence: The City lists 200 W Market Street, but its Get Directions link resolves to a trail point several miles south. The retained coordinate is the listed-address cross-check, not a reviewed trail-connection pin.
reviewQueue.recommended_next_action: Confirm the exact downtown trail entrance against York County GIS or field evidence before publishing navigation.

reviewQueue.conflict_or_missing_evidence: The County overview gives 274 Hess Farm Road, York, PA 17403 while the facility directory renders the same street address as Brogue, PA 17309.
reviewQueue.recommended_next_action: Ask the operator which postal locality should appear on a public guide; retain the official facility pin independently.

reviewQueue.conflict_or_missing_evidence: The City markets Kiwanis Lake and Farquhar Park together but lists separate map destinations in the outdoor-facilities directory.
reviewQueue.recommended_next_action: Review parcel and wayfinding evidence to decide whether to publish one combined parent or two adjacent parents.

reviewQueue.conflict_or_missing_evidence: Current City pages and the official map use Memorial Park Complex, Memorial Park, Veterans Memorial Park Complex, and Hoffman Softball Complex; listed street addresses also vary by facility.
reviewQueue.recommended_next_action: Use the whole-complex boundary and current entrance signs to choose the canonical parent name and primary arrival.

reviewQueue.conflict_or_missing_evidence: An older alert still says the nature center is closed, while the current Parks and Recreation page states it has reopened after renovations and lists current hours.
reviewQueue.recommended_next_action: Treat the current reopening page as controlling, but recheck the operator and remove or resolve the stale alert before launch.

reviewQueue.conflict_or_missing_evidence: The splash pad closes September 8, 2026 and is scheduled to reopen Memorial Day weekend 2027; ordinary park access is separate.
reviewQueue.recommended_next_action: Model the splash pad as a seasonal subsite with its own hours and recheck date; do not apply its closure to the parent park.

reviewQueue.conflict_or_missing_evidence: No reuse-cleared ground-level image set has been accepted for these eight parents. Operator-page images are discovery leads only, and aerial imagery is not a useful or approved substitute.
reviewQueue.recommended_next_action: Search public-domain government repositories and clearly licensed Wikimedia Commons media, then seek operator permission or community ground photography for remaining gaps.
